sourceChecks.text: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「all the borders of Israel」は境界・領域を表す地理用法で、人物集団IDには結び付けません。

sourceChecks.text: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: most certainly as I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Then the LORD may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the LORD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 直前文脈の「あなたの民」はソロモンの祈りが指すイスラエルの民と読める。

sourceChecks.text: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 直前文脈の「あなたの民」はソロモンの祈りが指すイスラエルの民と読める。

sourceChecks.text: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: King Solomon was king over all Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文はイスラエルを民・集団として明記する。

sourceChecks.text: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the LORD’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: of the nations concerning which the LORD said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s word, and returned and went their way, according to the LORD’s word.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD drove out before the children of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He said, “I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。
